mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP growth (GDPC1) above its 12-month moving average signals accelerating demand, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations rise.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 rises above its 12-month MA but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such instances, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below its 6-month moving average signals weakening manufacturing activity, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations fall.
failure_condition: If INDPRO falls below its 6-month MA but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals monetary tightening, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as discount rates rise and corporate earnings expectations fall.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS rises above 4.5% but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances, the hypothesis is falsified.
